caption: Loose snow is packed between mittened hands into a firm snowball that holds its shape when the hands open.

sa.check: Loose snow is gathered in mittened hands.
The hands open and the ball holds its shape.
The packing comes first, then the ball forms, then the hands open.

pc.expect: The snow compresses and sticks together under pressure, going from loose to a firm ball.
pc.fail: The snow stays powdery and falls through the fingers when packed; or it turns to liquid; or it hardens into a glassy ball.

pc.expect: The ball stays a ball after release and does not fall apart or spring back to loose snow.
pc.fail: It crumbles the instant the hands open; or it puffs back up into loose snow; or it splits into two balls.

pc.expect: The ball gets smaller and denser as it is packed, not larger.
pc.fail: It grows while being packed with no snow added; or it shrinks after the hands open; or it swells.

pc.expect: Loose snow that falls goes down.
pc.fail: Snow rises from the hands; or hangs in the air; or the ball floats between the hands.

pc.expect: One snowball forms and keeps its number.
pc.fail: The ball vanishes or a second appears; or it turns into another object; or it merges with a mitten.

pc.expect: The mittens and the background stay the same.
pc.fail: The mittens change colour; or the snow changes colour; or the background rearranges.
